IncidentDef.label: bastle sighting
IncidentDef.letterText: A wild {KIND} is passing through. It is a bastle: it carries traits no ordinary {KIND} has, and nobody knows yet what they are.\n\nIt can be hunted or tamed, and its traits come to light as you see them at work. If you leave it alone, it will move on in a couple of days.

IncidentDef.label: bastle pack
IncidentDef.letterText: A pack of manhunting {KINDPLURAL} has arrived, driven mad by scaria.\n\nThey will attack any human they see, and leave in a day or two.

IncidentDef.label: bastle rampage
IncidentDef.letterText: A powerful bastle {KIND} has wandered in on a rampage, driven mad by scaria.\n\nIt will attack any human it sees, and leave in a day or two.
